digest.component_or_area: DC rich-text live harness + inbound echo-suppression
propositions: Live DC harness must render representative rich-text bodies (heading/bold/code-macro) via real Jira DC instance and assert rendered HTML via ?expand=renderedFields, not just wiki source.
State-based echo-safety must hold end-to-end: a pushed rich body converges to baseline, then a second reconcile pass computes zero inbound/outbound mutations (no re-push of Jira's echo).

Settled conflict behavior under both-sides precondition: with a converged baseline, simultaneous rebar-side and Jira-side edits to description must keep rebar's value (local-wins) and emit deduped outbound-field-conflict bridge alert with remote value recorded, not silently destroyed.

Inbound differ must apply codec-aware echo-suppression mirroring outbound's _baseline_form_matches: treat Jira's description as unchanged when it equals the local body's landed wire form (map_fields_to_remote).
Cross-repo contract test must pin InboundMapper.normalize_rich_text signature and behavior so breaking changes to the seam exposed to agentic-dev-platform fail in rebar's test suite first.
